# scripts/Audio/MenuClock.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../../../../../../Users/tinkertailorr/a-world-of-darkness-alpha/scripts/Audio/MenuClock.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../../../../../../../Users/tinkertailorr/a-world-of-darkness-alpha/docs/systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

The menu score's musical time, from the stem player's position in seconds.
Pure functions: MenuMusic reads its player through them, tests call them.

Base: `not declared`. Registered class: `MenuClock`.
